combo1.title: Elemental Saga: Invoked Extender Loop
combo1.description: Turn 2 or later, after a hand-trap exchange has left FIRE, LIGHT and EARTH in your Graveyard. Aleister becomes Artemis to add DARK as a fourth Attribute, so Elemental Saga Doriado can revive Aleister and still keep her Deck effect live. Invocation turns Aleister and Artemis into Invoked Mechaba without touching the Graveyard, then Doriado pulls Barrier Statue of the Abyss as the last card of the turn. Nobody can respond to either Doriado effect. Starting hand: Elemental Saga Doriado + Aleister the Invoker.

steps.text: Normal Summon Aleister the Invoker (DARK). Your Graveyard already holds FIRE (Ash Blossom), LIGHT (Effect Veiler) and EARTH (Ghost Belle) from your opponent's turn.
Activate effect: Aleister the Invoker was Normal Summoned.
Add Invocation from your Deck to your hand.
Send Aleister the Invoker (a Level 4 Spellcaster) to the Graveyard as material. The Graveyard now shows 4 Attributes: FIRE, LIGHT, EARTH and DARK.
Link Summon Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden.
Activate effect: Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand, targeting Aleister. Neither player can respond.
Special Summon Aleister the Invoker from the Graveyard. FIRE, LIGHT and EARTH stay in the Graveyard, so her Deck effect is still live. A Special Summon does not trigger Aleister's Invocation effect.
Special Summon Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand.
Activate Invocation. Aleister and Artemis are on your field, so you can banish them as material instead of using Graveyard monsters.
Banish Aleister the Invoker from your field as material.
Banish Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden, a LIGHT monster, from your field as material. Your Graveyard keeps all three hand traps.
Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba (Aleister the Invoker + 1 LIGHT monster).
Invocation goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Elemental Saga Doriado on the field. With Aleister banished, DARK is not on your field or in your Graveyard. Nobody can respond.
Special Summon Barrier Statue of the Abyss from your Deck. From now on only DARK monsters can be Special Summoned, which is why the Statue comes last.
Activate effect: Invocation in the Graveyard. Shuffle it into your Deck.
Add the banished Aleister to your hand, ready to Normal Summon next turn.

combo2.title: Elemental Saga: Elementsaber Attribute Injection
combo2.description: A going-first line from Palace of the Elemental Lords, Elementsaber Makani, Elementsaber Molehu and Elemental Saga Doriado. Palace pays Lapauila Mana's cost from the Deck, Makani and Knightmare Cerberus fill the Graveyard, and Molehu declares a new Attribute so that DARK is the only one Doriado can pull: Barrier Statue of the Abyss. The revived Makani is a new card, so it can use its effect again. Palace's own search skips the Battle Phase of your next turn.

steps.text: Activate Palace of the Elemental Lords.
Palace of the Elemental Lords adds Elementsaber Lapauila Mana from your Deck to your hand. In exchange, you skip the Battle Phase of your next turn.
Activate effect: Elementsaber Lapauila Mana from your hand. Palace lets you pay the cost with 2 Elementsabers from your Deck instead of your hand.
Send Elementsaber Malo (FIRE) from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Send Elementsaber Nalu (WATER) from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Special Summon Elementsaber Lapauila Mana.
Normal Summon Elementsaber Makani.
Activate effect: Elementsaber Makani.
Send Elementsaber Molehu (DARK) from your hand to the Graveyard. The Graveyard now has FIRE, WATER and DARK.
Add Elementsaber Lapauila from your Deck to your hand.
Send Elementsaber Makani to the Graveyard as material.
Send Elementsaber Lapauila Mana to the Graveyard as material.
Link Summon Knightmare Cerberus (2 monsters with different names). The Graveyard now holds FIRE, WATER, DARK, WIND and LIGHT.

Activate effect: Elementsaber Molehu in the Graveyard. Declare FIRE: until the end of the turn, Molehu counts as FIRE there, so DARK is gone from your Graveyard. Do this now, before the fifth summon of the turn.
Activate effect: Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand, targeting Elementsaber Makani. Nobody can respond.
Special Summon Elementsaber Makani from the Graveyard. FIRE, WATER and LIGHT stay in the Graveyard, so her Deck effect is still live.
Special Summon Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand.

Activate effect: Elemental Saga Doriado on the field. Knightmare Cerberus is EARTH, Makani is WIND and Doriado is LIGHT, so DARK is the only Attribute missing from your field and Graveyard. Nobody can respond.
Special Summon Barrier Statue of the Abyss from your Deck. From now on only DARK monsters can be Special Summoned.
Activate effect: Elementsaber Makani again. It left the field and came back, so its once-per-turn effect is available again.
Send Elementsaber Lapauila from your hand to the Graveyard.
Add a second Elementsaber Molehu from your Deck to your hand for next turn.

combo3.title: Elemental Saga: One-Card Chaos Angel (Going Second)
combo3.description: Going second after your opponent's first turn, the three hand traps you used are in your Graveyard: FIRE, LIGHT and EARTH. Elemental Saga Doriado revives Ash Blossom with nothing able to respond, and the Level 3 Tuner plus Level 7 LIGHT Doriado make Chaos Angel. With exactly three Attributes, reviving one switches off the Deck effect for this turn, so this line spends Doriado on the Synchro Summon instead.

steps.text: Activate effect: Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand, targeting Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring. Your Graveyard has FIRE, LIGHT and EARTH. Nobody can respond, so Ghost Belle, Called by the Grave and D.D. Crow can't touch the target.
Special Summon Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring from your Graveyard.
Special Summon Elemental Saga Doriado from your hand. Only LIGHT and EARTH are left in the Graveyard, so the Deck effect is off this turn.
Send Ash Blossom (Level 3 Tuner) to the Graveyard as material.
Send Elemental Saga Doriado (Level 7, LIGHT) to the Graveyard as material.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel (Level 10). Because a LIGHT monster was material, your Synchro Monsters are unaffected by monster effects your opponent activates.
Activate effect: Chaos Angel was Special Summoned, so banish 1 card on the field, such as your opponent's strongest negation.
